summary.text: Ann Cummings is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Washington District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A former mayor of Montpelier, she has served in the Senate since 1997 and chairs the Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cummings earned a bachelor's degree from Cardinal Cushing College in 1968 and a master of science in administration from Saint Michael's College in 1989.
She has worked as a realtor, as a social service worker for Project Independence and as owner of Core Designs, and she served as mayor of Montpelier.
Cummings's 2025-2026 committee assignments are chair of the Finance Committee and membership on the Health and Welfare Committee.
